about: Neural network models for time series forecasting, built to be easy to use and to scale.

prs.title: Models with a probability loss can be saved right after training
prs.broken: Saving a model right after training failed when it used one of the probability losses. The loss still held a link to the training math that could not be copied.
prs.changed: That link is now dropped where the loss is built. It was only needed for predictions, which still work the same.
prs.matters: People can train a forecasting model and save it straight away without a crash.

prs.title: In-sample forecasts work with category series ids
prs.broken: When series ids were stored as categories, asking for in-sample forecasts crashed with one series or with more than two.
prs.changed: The results are now joined the same way cross-validation already joins them.
prs.matters: Users with category ids get their forecasts instead of an error, with the same output as text ids.

prs.title: IQLoss returns the quantiles you ask for
prs.broken: With the IQLoss model, asking for the 10% quantile came back as the 5% forecast, because fixed forecasts were treated as random samples.
prs.changed: Each requested quantile is now predicted directly, and simulation reads them off a sorted grid.
prs.matters: Forecast ranges now mean what they say, so risk numbers built on them are right.
